details: Presidents Trump, Xi, and Putin met at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026, to discuss global issues, including trade barriers, artificial intelligence, and regional conflicts. Despite a "peace declaration," the summit concluded without major breakthroughs, particularly regarding the contentious US-China trade truce and American restrictions on China's access to advanced AI chips. The persistent tech rivalry and the potential for new hostilities remain significant concerns for the global economy.
title: US, China, Russia Leaders Discuss Trade, AI at APEC Summit Amid Tensions

details: Kristalina Georgieva, the Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), warned on November 19, 2026, that the surging global demand for artificial intelligence will compel central banks worldwide to raise interest rates. While noting AI's contribution to stronger-than-expected economic growth in some regions despite global headwinds, higher interest rates generally reduce the attractiveness of riskier assets for investors.
title: IMF Head Warns Booming AI Demand to Drive Up Global Interest Rates

details: The United States is increasing efforts to block China's remote access to advanced AI chips, following suspicions that a Singapore-based data center company, Megaspeed, diverted Nvidia GPUs to China in violation of US export controls. A criminal investigation is now underway, intensifying the ongoing US-China technological and economic rivalry. This escalation could further impact global supply chains and tech markets.
title: US Intensifies AI Chip Export Controls Amid Nvidia Diversion Scandal

details: On November 20, 2026, Britain and the European Union reached new agreements aimed at removing trade barriers and facilitating youth movement, signaling an effort to strengthen their post-Brexit relationship. However, more significant discussions regarding a potential softening or reversal of Brexit have been deferred. This development occurs as both economies continue to navigate challenges from global inflation and regional conflicts.
title: UK and EU Agree New Trade, Youth Pacts; Defer Brexit Reversal Talks
